behavior_scoring.equal_behavior: for each runtime, task and lifecycle observation, compare objective success and critical-violation status to raw; unknown is not equal
behavior_scoring.success_rule: strict equality with the hidden generated oracle

correlation.formula: sha256(chain id NUL observation index NUL lifecycle id), where chain id binds runtime, arm, the five-task sequence and repetition

telemetry_unknown_policy: a missing native category remains unknown unless the cited provider semantics permit an exact derivation; negative or overlapping categories refuse

workload.admission_filter: execute chains only for arms returned by the frozen behavioral admission rule; raw and simple remain mandatory; record every excluded chain
workload.provider_event_accounting: retain every provider-native usage event in each turn; complete logical context high-water is the maximum event input, fresh churn is the sum over events, score only the terminal bounded JSON, and mark unexpected extra answer-producing calls inconclusive
workload.schedule_order: for each runtime and repetition run the raw/simple mandatory-baseline tier before the admission-filtered candidate tier, sort by chain id inside each tier, and execute each chain's observations in index order

session_schedule.process: start fresh runtime process in the isolated store
session_schedule.session: create one persistent session or thread
session_schedule.task: score the mapped authority decision task

session_schedule.cache_evidence: record warm read, write and miss categories
session_schedule.session: reuse the same session or thread
session_schedule.task: score the mapped failure tool-invocation task

session_schedule.cache_evidence: resume before the observed runtime TTL expires
session_schedule.process: stop, then restart the runtime process
session_schedule.session: resume the same persisted session or thread
session_schedule.task: score the mapped recovery refusal task after resume

session_schedule.cache_evidence: wait observed TTL plus the frozen safety margin, then require a later miss or mark the runtime inconclusive
session_schedule.process: stop, wait, then restart the runtime process
session_schedule.session: resume the same persisted session or thread
session_schedule.task: score the mapped exact-literal plan task after expiry

session_schedule.cache_evidence: record usage only after native compaction completes
session_schedule.process: keep the resumed runtime process alive
session_schedule.session: compact the same session or thread, require the native completion event, then start one new turn
session_schedule.task: score the mapped cross-document recovery task after compaction

workload.task_sequence: materialize five distinct committed behavioral tasks, one per semantic class and lifecycle; keep the representation prefix stable, change the task suffix at every turn, retain every response and score every observation
